headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.executableSampler_contract
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ) (hs : xs.sum = ys.sum) (t : ℕ),
  have htotal := ⋯;
  ∃ q sample,
    q = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawHybridWordWidth xs ys t ∧
      (∀ (word : Fin q → Bool),
          Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawHybridSamplerCode xs ys t (List.ofFn word) =
            OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑(sample word)) ∧
        ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw sample)
              OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw) ≤
          ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t)
